# Compatibility fixtures

Generated by the Python v3.0 build. Do not edit by hand. Regenerate with:

    python scripts/gen_compat_fixtures.py

`undo/meta.json` and `config/expected.json` record the Python commit they came
from. The fixtures were generated on Windows; tests adapt the recorded paths
(and case-insensitive `fnmatch` results) when run on Linux/macOS.
